subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw ship this complete first-party Wear OS conversation and voice surface now, or stage it after the narrower status bridge in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803?
rationale: The change creates a new first-party app surface, persistent UI defaults, versioned phone/watch protocols, release artifacts, and ongoing compatibility obligations; tests cannot determine the intended product scope or staging strategy.

options.title: Stage the foundation first
options.body: Review and land the narrow status bridge first, then rebase this PR to its unique conversation, voice, release, and proof work.

options.title: Sponsor the complete surface
options.body: Approve the full Wear product direction and require the release/versioning findings and voice proof to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Pause the Wear app
options.body: Keep both PRs unmerged until Android ownership and release planning explicitly prioritize a first-party Wear application.

recommendation.title: Stage the foundation first
recommendation.body: Review and land the narrow status bridge first, then rebase this PR to its unique conversation, voice, release, and proof work.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository's Android documentation identifies this handle as the Android app owner, and the decision spans Android product scope and release packaging.
